# Pre-existing `_msuf*` frame fields that are read but never written anywhere in
# the shipped tree. Read by .github/scripts/msuf_static_checks.py
# (check_frame_fields). Ratchet: this list may only shrink. A new writer-less
# read fails the static checks instead of being added here.
#
# Unlike msuf_frame_fields_allowlist.txt, nothing on this list is correct. Each
# entry is a read that can only ever see nil: dead compatibility code, a hook
# nothing stamps any more, or a wrong name. Fixing one means deleting its line
# (stale entries are reported on every run). Prune by hand - the grouping
# comments below are the only documentation these fields have.
#
# One exact field name per line; `#` starts a comment.

# --- Retired square-border / highlight implementation -----------------------
# UnitFrames/Effects/MSUF_UF_RoundedFrames.lua defensively hides the artifacts
# of the pre-6.0 border and mouseover-highlight modules (see
# UnitFrames/Engine/Elements/MSUF_UF_Highlight.lua, which the TOC no longer
# loads). Every read is `if f.X and f.X.Hide then`, so nil is harmless; nothing
# has written these since the Borders/RoundedFrames rewrite.
# _msufBarOutline is additionally read by Castbars/MSUF_CastbarAnchors.lua as a
# "legacy rectangular frame exposes its own outline host" width source.
_msufBarOutline
_msufBehindBarBg
_msufDetachedPBOutline
_msufGFBorderFrame
_msufGFDebuffStripe
_msufGFHighlightBorder
_msufGFOutlineLines
_msufHLA
_msufHLActivePrio
_msufHLB
_msufHLEdgeSz
_msufHLG
_msufHLOfs
_msufHLR
_msufHighlightActiveKey
_msufHighlightColorKey
_msufHighlightOutline
_msufHighlightOutlineB
_msufHighlightOutlineG
_msufHighlightOutlineR
_msufPowerBorder
_msufRoundedGFShell
_msufRoundedShell

# --- Auras3 -> engine override hooks that Auras3 never stamps ---------------
# The debuff-stripe and dispel-border readers take `frame._msufA3X or cfg.X`,
# so the configured value always wins and the aura-driven override is dead
# (matches the 2026-09 finding that the Borders dispel path is unreachable).
# _msufA3SkipDirectIdentityRefresh is a per-container opt-out of the direct
# identity refresh route that nothing sets.
# Read: UnitFrames/Engine/Group/MSUF_UF_Group_Visuals.lua,
# UnitFrames/Engine/Elements/MSUF_UF_Elements_Borders.lua,
# Auras3/Runtime/MSUF_Auras3_Runtime_IdentityEvents.lua.
_msufA3DebuffStripeA
_msufA3DebuffStripeActive
_msufA3DebuffStripeB
_msufA3DebuffStripeEdge
_msufA3DebuffStripeG
_msufA3DebuffStripeHeight
_msufA3DebuffStripeR
_msufA3DispelA
_msufA3DispelActive
_msufA3DispelB
_msufA3DispelG
_msufA3DispelR
_msufA3SkipDirectIdentityRefresh

# --- Edit Mode popup: overlay pieces of a skin that no longer attaches -------
# Shell/UI/MSUF_EditPopupUI.lua kills these overlay regions so a skinned button
# keeps its own look. Nothing in the shipped tree (Shell/UI/MSUF_Style.lua,
# Shell/UI/MSUF_MapkoSkin.lua) creates them, so every Kill call is a no-op.
_msufBtnBG
_msufBtnDisabled
_msufBtnDown
_msufBtnHover
_msufMidnightBackdrop
_msufPeelBorder
_msufPeelFill

# --- Engine flags and hooks with no writer ----------------------------------
# _msufGFBuilt: group-frame marker; live code uses _msufGFKind.
#   Read: Runtime/MSUF_UIScaleRuntime.lua.
# _msufGFNameHiddenForStatus: GF.ShouldShowNameText's status override; the
#   status element never sets it. Read: GroupFrames/MSUF_GroupFrames_DB.lua.
# _msufHealthColorByHealth: health-text colour mode gate.
#   Read: UnitFrames/Engine/Elements/MSUF_UF_Text_Common.lua.
# _msufPowerBarReserved: portrait anchor override.
#   Read: UnitFrames/Engine/Elements/MSUF_UF_Elements_Portrait.lua.
# _msufPowerBgDynamic: the power-bar twin of _msufHealthBgDynamic, which
#   MSUF_UF_Elements_Health.lua does write; the Power element writes no
#   counterpart, so the dynamic power background never engages. Read:
#   MSUF_UF_Elements_BarsCommon.lua, Group/MSUF_UF_Group_Visuals.lua.
# _msufUnit: last link of the castbar unit-key fallback chain
#   (frame.unit or frame.MSUF_unit or frame._msufUnit or frame.unitKey).
#   Read: Castbars/MSUF_CastbarUtils.lua, Castbars/MSUF_CastbarVisuals.lua.
# _msufModernFactoryProfile_v1: provenance marker gating three factory-profile
#   repairs. Only tools/profile_apply_smoke.lua sets it, so in a real install
#   all three repairs are unreachable. Read: State/MSUF_Defaults.lua.
_msufGFBuilt
_msufGFNameHiddenForStatus
_msufHealthColorByHealth
_msufModernFactoryProfile_v1
_msufPowerBarReserved
_msufPowerBgDynamic
_msufUnit

# --- Wrong name (defect) ----------------------------------------------------
# Runtime/MSUF_FontRuntime.lua fans the name font out to `f._msufToTInlineSep`
# and `f._msufToTInlineText`. The target-of-target inline regions are actually
# `frame.totInlineSep` / `frame.totInlineText` (created and listed as such in
# UnitFrames/Engine/Elements/MSUF_UF_Text_Layout.lua), so the inline ToT
# separator and text never receive the font update. Renaming the two reads is a
# behaviour change and is left to the owner.
